sites.name: base_framebuffer_geometry
sites.evidence: Exact CUSA07413 01.36 SELF 19e9f057 / ELF 90880b52. Single MOV EDI,1920 at 0xe66de inside 0xe5800; next MOV ECX,ESI then CALL 0x35b190(renderW,renderH,outputW,outputH,1). No call/consumer between four global dimension stores and this site. Preserve original RDI zero-extension, flags and all other registers except base-mode RSI/RDX args. Validate console mode and original dimensions before updating all four globals and three args. Pro branch and table unchanged. No resize of live resources; selection requires restart and runtime disable does not undo allocations. Adaptation of illusion 720p patch: https://github.com/illusionyy/PS-Game-Patch/blob/main/patches/xml/GodOfWar-Orbis.xml, blob 76db50465ba870f4c4aea642a1cb1839131bd683. Original public XML does not list CUSA07413; this port is bound to exact local executable identity.
